The following events took place in '''22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 13''' after the [[Great ReSynchronization]] and '''Year 978''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Events==
*13:3:3&mdash;The ''[[Elegant Wake]]'', a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] operated by [[Romodi Interstellar]] and carrying [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] refugees, departs from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="HNN Sy Myrth">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_5.html|Merson Pirates Attack Sy Myrth Liner}}</ref>
*13:3:6&mdash;On the general channels of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] announces 5:16 as the date for a full [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].<ref name="HNN vote">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_1.html|Palpatine Sets Army Vote Date}}</ref> [[Beolars Bribbs/Legends|Beolars Bribbs]] becomes the [[President of the Sullustan Council]] and the CEO of [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].<ref name="HNN Sullust">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_1.html|Sullustans Elect President}}</ref>
*13:3:7&mdash;A three-hour long brawl between [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] immigrants at the [[Eastport/Legends|Eastport]] processing station on Coruscant leaves 15 dead and 45 wounded.<ref name="HNN brawl">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_4.html|15 Dead in Houk / Weequay Brawl at Eastport}}</ref>
*13:3:13&mdash;In protest of the Military Creation Act, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] announces that [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] will close its borders and withdraw from the upcoming vote.<ref name="HNN Corellia">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref> A [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] centered in mountains 45 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] west of [[Calius saj Leeloo|Calius Saj Leeloo]] strikes the most populous [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]].<ref name="HNN Berchest">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|regional/13314_1.html|Groundquakes Hit Berchest Cities}}</ref>
*13:3:14&mdash;Corellia closes its borders.<ref name="HNN Corellian Jedi">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|jediwatch/1352_2.html|Corellian Jedi Return}}</ref> [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ebareebaveebeedee]], ruler of the [[Squib Polyanarchy]], declares his loyalty to the Galactic Senate and affirms the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs']] allegiance to the Galactic Republic in a planetwide statement to the populace of [[Skor II]].<ref name="HNN Squibs">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|regional/13314_2.html|Squibs Announce They're "Going Nowhere."}}</ref>
*13:3:18&mdash;The [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Resettlement Coalition]] is set up under the direction of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] to discuss possible options in relocating citizens displaced as a result of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN RRC">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_1.html|Mid Rim Worlds Open Ports to Refugees}}</ref>
*13:3:20&mdash;Senator [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]] retires from politics in an informal gathering of friends and colleagues at his family compound on [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]].<ref name="HNN retirement">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref>
*13:3:21&mdash;Peace negotiations between [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] begin as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], leading a group of [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] and [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] peace officers, arrives at the Trandoshan city of [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]] to meet with Kashyyyk Senator [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] and Trandoshan [[Speaker-Above-All]] [[Hadocrassk]].<ref name="HNN Kashyyyk 1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_1.html|Kashyyyk/Trandoshan Talks to Shaky Start}}</ref>
*13:3:28&mdash;In anticipation of future negotiations with Separatists, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine reveals the members of the newly-formed [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]: Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Darsana/Legends|Darsana]] of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]], [[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]] of [[Sermeria]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Ronet Coorr]] of [[Iseno/Legends|Iseno]], [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]] of [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], and [[Havriso Looruya]] of [[Yir Tangee/Legends|Yir Tangee]], along with acting Senator [[Zo Howler]] of Gravlex Med.<ref name="HNN committee">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref>
*13:4:4&mdash;Senator Aks Moe is assassinated on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="HNN Aak">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_2.html|Senator Aak Officially Appointed}}</ref> Peace negotiations between Kashyyyk and Trandosha disintegrate when [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] delegates learn that a Trandoshan effort to obtain representation in the Galactic Senate received aid from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="HNN Kashyyyk 2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|regional/1344_1.html|Kashyyyk / Trandoshan Talks Break Down}}</ref> The [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] secedes from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN Lahara 1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_4.html|Lahara Sector Secedes}}</ref>
*13:4:10&mdash;Twenty students from a [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]] sociology tour group attempt to infiltrate the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and reach the [[Second Atrium Lobby]] before [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contain them.<ref name="HNN temple">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|jediwatch/13411_1.html|Activists Deface Jedi Temple Lobby}}</ref>
*13:4:11&mdash;[[Dug/Legends|Dug]] activists demanding an end to [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] rule of the Dug [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Malastare disrupt the funeral of Senator Aks Moe.<ref name="HNN funeral">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|regional/13411_1.html|Moe Funeral Disrupted by Dug Activists}}</ref> [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] announce their endorsement and adoption of the [[Sienar Advanced Systems]] [[SIE-TIE twin ion engine|twin ion engine]].<ref name="HNN TIE">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|business/13411_1.html|Successful Engine Tests Cause Sienar Stock Surge}}</ref>
*13:4:18&mdash;During a session of the Galactic Senate, Senator [[Esu Rotsino/Legends|Esu Rotsino]] of [[Abrion Major/Legends|Abrion Major]] issues [[Articles of Secession/Legends|Articles of Secession]] as the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] secedes from the Galactic Republic, prompting the Senate to debate the approval of emergency subsidy packages for food-producing sectors that remain in the Republic.<ref name="HNN Abrion">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_1.html|Abrion Sector Secedes; Separatists Get Agri-Worlds}}</ref>
*13:4:24&mdash;The Galactic Senate and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] approve legislation that increases restrictions on the distribution and usage of [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] and related technologies, imposing strict export tariffs on cloaking components such as [[Stygium/Legends|stygium crystals]] mined in the [[Dreighton Nebula/Legends|Dreighton Nebula]], in an effort to prevent unfavorable owners from obtaining such devices and to help preserve the dwindling stockpiles of non-renewable cloaking resources found on [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]].<ref name="HNN cloaking">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|business/13425_2.html|New Cloaking Legislation in Effect}}</ref>
*13:4:25&mdash;While on a routine patrol mission, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zozridor Slayke]] and the 150-being crew of the ''[[Scarlet Thranta]]'', a mid-sized [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]<ref name="HNN Thranta">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|jediwatch/1359_1.html|Jedi Taskforce Dispatched to Reel in Thranta}}</ref> belonging to the Judicial Department,<ref name="HNN Sluis">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|regional/13516_3.html|Sluis Van Offer Met with Doubt}}</ref> defect from the Galactic Republic<ref name="HNN Thranta" /> to engage Separatist elements in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="HNN Sluis" /> During a session of the Galactic Senate, [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] is officially recognized as Senator of Malastare.<ref name="HNN Aak" /> While returning from the [[Ansion Embassy]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] thwart an attempt by [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] maintenance worker [[Gavrilonnis Tejere]] to sabotage the [[Yag'Dhul Ambassadorial Landing Platform]].<ref name="HNN saboteur">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_1.html|Would-Be Saboteur Captured}}</ref>
*13:5:1&mdash;During the tabling of a bond issue, Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] accuses Loyalist Committee member Havriso Looriya of funding secessionist activity and refuses to relinquish the Senate floor until the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] gives attention to his claims.<ref name="HNN conspiracy">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_2.html|Rodian Senator Uncovers Loyalist-Separatist Ties}}</ref>
*13:5:2&mdash;[[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] and its domains formally secede from the Galactic Republic, with Senator [[Daggibus Scoritoles]] transmitting [[Articles of Secession/Legends|Articles of Secession]] to the Galactic Senate via HoloNet.<ref name="HNN Yag'Dhul">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|regional/1352_1.html|Yag'Dhul Secedes}}</ref> The Senate Bureau of Intelligence issues an announcement upholding Onaconda Farr's allegations against Havriso Looriya.<ref name="HNN conspiracy" /> The [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] votes to remain in the Galactic Republic in spite of attempts by pro-secessionist mercenaries to disrupt the process.<ref name="HNN Ansion">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|jediwatch/1352_1.html|Jedi Settle Ansion Dispute}}</ref>
*13:5:9&mdash;[[Vice Chair/Legends|Speaker of the Senate]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] announces the appointment of Senator Onaconda Farr to the Loyalist Committee.<ref name="HNN Farr">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_4.html|Senator Farr Named to Loyalist Committee}}</ref>
*13:5:15&mdash;Separatist extremists open fire on the [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue Corp]] rescue cutter ''[[Iron Tether]]'' in the Lahara sector.<ref name="HNN Lahara 2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|regional/13516_1.html|Lahara Patrol Attacked, Jedi to Send Aid}}</ref>
*13:5:16&mdash;[[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]], [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]], and [[Llollulion]] escape from the [[Moderate Security Ward]] of the [[CoCo Penitentiary|Coco Penitentiary]] on Coruscant by boarding a supply truck servicing the penitentiary's laundry wing.<ref name="HNN Faytonni">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|news/13516_2.html|Coco District Jailbreak Alert}}</ref>
*[[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]] assumed [[Lanus Wrede]]'s former seat as [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Sermeria]].
*[[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on [[Kip]].
*[[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], and [[Tantra]] seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
*Senators [[Bufus Ritsomas]], [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]] and [[Wuja Wojaine]] were arrested on charges of using their positions to lead a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] ring.
*13:5:16&mdash;[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], under orders of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] protected Amidala on the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]], in order to prevent her from being targeted for assassination once more.
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] High [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] to [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|track]] Fett's whereabouts, which lead him to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] world of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
*The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] found that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] had placed an order for a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] with the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].
*Kenobi informed the Jedi Council that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was prepared to [[Clone Wars/Legends|go to war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
*[[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Massacre]] of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|tribe]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by Skywalker after [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]] to death.
*Yoda made contact with the disembodied [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].
*The [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] was completed.
*13:5:21<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>&mdash;The Galactic Senate, led by [[Junior Representative/Legends|acting]] Senator [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], granted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] significantly more emergency powers than they [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|did]] [[24 BBY/Legends|2 years earlier]].
*13:5:21<ref name="Date" />&mdash;The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] began the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars that also brought an end to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].
*In the [[Geonosian War Room/Legends|War Room]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] gave the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plan design]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Ultimate Weapon]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
*Kenobi and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Skywalker, and later [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Yoda [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Dooku in [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|Dooku's hangar]] on Geonosis. During the duel, Dooku caused a diversion that threatened the lives of Skywalker and Kenobi, and Yoda was forced to save them, an act that Dooku took advantage of and escaped the [[Geonosis system/Legends|system]].
*[[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] is formed by Chancellor Palpatine by handpicking clones showing very high skill in battle.
*Dooku delivered the plan design for the Ultimate Weapon to his master at [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on Coruscant.
*Skywalker and Amidala secretly wedded on Naboo.
*Jedi Master [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] created his own [[Kota's Militia|militia]] at a stronghold, since he did not trust the Grand Army of the Republic.
*The [[Occupation of Karthakk]] came to an end after ten years.
*[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] ended as its channel was seized for use by the Grand Army of the Republic.
*The [[hunt for the Decimator]].
*[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] joined the Jedi Council, replacing [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]].
*The [[Dark Reaper]] project by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
*[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was recruited by Dooku on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]].
*Skywalker and Ventress [[Duel on Yavin 4|dueled]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], while at the same time Kenobi [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|fought]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].
*The Jedi and the Republic [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|learned]] of the existence of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
*[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was permanently covered in gold plating.
*Kenobi became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Mission to Ruul (Clone Wars)|mission]] to [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]].
*The [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]] were defeated by the Jedi.
*An [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] fundraiser was held on [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].
*An [[arqet]] escaped its [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]] handlers on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], ending the Circus's illegal shows.
*[[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
*The Occupation of [[Kynachi]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] came to an end after ten years.
*The planet [[Dagu]] was [[Battle on Dagu|liberated]] from the CIS by [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].
*[[Jobal Rapier]] and [[Yari Cranna-Rapier]] separate.<ref name="hnn life">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|life/13411_3.html|Jobal and Yari Split Up}}</ref>
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].
*[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] became Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].
*[[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was kidnapped by the Confederacy of Independent [[Star system/Legends|Systems]], but was rescued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and so began their affiliation with [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] against the CIS.
*[[Itipiniwi]] won Best in Show at the [[Annual Mid-Rim Domesticated Sub-Sentient Show]].<ref name="Hnn-Best in Show Eaten by Second-Best">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|life/1337_1.html|Best in Show Eaten by Second-Best}}</ref>
*[[Church of Infinite Perception/Legends|Church of Infinite Perception]] revolution on [[Pergitor]].<ref name="Hnn-Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}</ref>
